questions.prompt: A stream has sent the tool-call delta '{"path":' and nothing more for that block. Why does the program not parse the arguments yet?
options: The arguments arrive only in the usage piece
The slice is not valid JSON until the remaining slices arrive
The finish piece must come first
questions.explanation: Tool arguments stream as slices of one JSON string. '{"path":' is half of '{"path":"notes.txt"}', so it can only be parsed once the block ends.

questions.prompt: Two text deltas arrive with index 0, and a tool-call delta arrives with index 1. What does the index tell the program?
options: The order in which the pieces must be shown
How many tokens each piece holds
Which block of the reply each piece belongs to
questions.explanation: The index ties each piece to one block. Pieces with index 0 build the text block, and pieces with index 1 build the tool-call block.

questions.prompt: DeepSeek ends a reply with the stop reason end_turn. What does the loop in mini-dsh see?
options: A finish piece with kind stop
A finish piece with kind end_turn
A usage piece with no finish piece
A block-end piece with kind stop
questions.explanation: The code that reads DeepSeek converts its names into the shared list, so end_turn becomes a finish piece with kind stop and the loop never sees DeepSeek's own names.
